description: Recommend the Actual group agency, office, training centre or school best suited to a person's need, near a place in France. Covers employment agencies (intérim, CDD, CDI), Actual Talent offices (talent acquisition and assessment, mostly white-collar), Envergure centres (vocational training, skills assessment, career transition) and the group's schools (eSUP, Holberton…, often work-study). Ranks them by open offers for the given job, specialty (construction, logistics, medical, white-collar, school domain…) and distance. Returns address, phone, opening status and why each agency was picked. Pass the returned agency code to search_offers (agencyCode) to list that agency's offers.

job.description: Job or field the person is looking for or hiring for, e.g. "électricien", "cariste", "aide-soignant".

limit.description: Number of agencies to return, 1 to 5. Defaults to 3.

location.description: French town or postal code, e.g. "Le Mans" or "72000".

purpose.description: find_job: a candidate looking for work (default). hire: a company looking to recruit. assessment: a company wanting candidates or staff assessed (Actual Talent). training: vocational training, skills assessment or career change (Envergure). school: a degree or work-study programme (group schools). insertion: return-to-work support.

name: find_best_agency
title: Find the most relevant Actual group agency
